quote.text: I need to prepare for a homeschool evaluation

promise.text: Homeschool evaluation: what to bring and how to prepare

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "homeschool", "evaluat"

lines.text: What an evaluator looks for, a six-item folder list, and how to get ready in one evening.
Ask your own evaluator or state what it requires.

head.text: Confirm with your evaluator: meeting time, location, and anything specific they want to see.
Pull one dated work sample per subject from early in the year and one from recently.
Write a subject and curriculum list, one line each.
Add a short note per subject: what changed, what was hard, what you'd do differently.
Put it all in one folder, in the order your evaluator will likely go through it.

items.text: The log of what was covered, with dates, even if approximate.
Work samples from more than one point in the year, not just one strong stretch.
A list of curricula and materials used.
Attendance or days schooled, if your state counts them.
Test results, if your state requires them.
A short note per subject on where you started and where you got to.

line.text: Print the record for one child. It contains only what you chose to include, and it says what is in it rather than how it is going.
